stories.headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna on GitHub
stories.blurb: OpenAI has officially integrated its new GPT-6 Sol and Luna models into GitHub, bringing next-generation frontier intelligence directly to developer workflows.

stories.headline: OpenAI Internal Model Solves Over 100 Landmark Math Problems
stories.blurb: OpenAI revealed that a newly trained internal model has successfully solved over 100 long-standing mathematical problems, demonstrating unprecedented leaps in AI reasoning capabilities.

stories.headline: Jev Introduces Highly Efficient 'Decision Models'
stories.blurb: A new architectural paradigm called Jev introduces "Decision Models" built on Qwen, shifting how LLMs handle structured reasoning by focusing on highly optimized binary decision outputs.

stories.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 Debuts on Vercel AI Gateway
stories.blurb: Anthropic's highly anticipated Claude Opus 5.5 model is now live on Vercel's AI Gateway, giving developers access to top-tier agentic reasoning capabilities.

stories.headline: Grok 4.7 Sets New Benchmarks for Price and Performance
stories.blurb: An in-depth analysis of xAI's new Grok 4.7 (xhigh) shows massive improvements in intelligence and cost efficiency, shaking up the competitive landscape of frontier models.

stories.headline: Hackers Claim Massive Breach of FBI Employee Records
stories.blurb: Threat actors claim to have breached secure databases and exfiltrated sensitive personal data belonging to all FBI employees, raising major national security concerns.

stories.headline: CLOSEDQUORUM Malware Employs AI to Autonomously Target Victims
stories.blurb: A newly discovered Windows malware family called CLOSEDQUORUM utilizes local AI models to dynamically evaluate systems and select post-compromise actions without human operator intervention.

stories.headline: Patch Gap Exploited to Deliver Chrome and Windows 0-Days
stories.blurb: Attackers are actively taking advantage of patch-release delays to deliver highly targeted Google Chrome and Microsoft Windows zero-day exploits using spoofed websites.

stories.headline: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Standards Buckle Under New Attacks
stories.blurb: Researchers have exposed critical vulnerabilities in the HAWK signature scheme and McEliece cryptosystem parameters, forcing a vital re-evaluation of quantum-resistant security protocols.

stories.headline: Meta Details 'Petal' Petabit-Class Transoceanic Subsea Cable
stories.blurb: Meta has shared details on the engineering behind Petal, the world’s first petabit-class subsea cable designed to handle massive cross-continental bandwidth demands for global AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: Raspberry Pi 5 RAM Upgrades Locked Down via Firmware
stories.blurb: Raspberry Pi has locked out unauthorized third-party RAM modifications on the Pi 5 via a firmware update, sparking frustration in the open-source hardware and maker communities.

stories.headline: Google Open-Sources 'AX' Agentic Orchestrator for Kubernetes
stories.blurb: Google has open-sourced AX, a native Kubernetes orchestrator designed to scale, manage, and coordinate fleets of autonomous AI agents in production environments.

stories.headline: M5 Ultra Mac Studio Reviewed as the Ultimate Local AI Workstation
stories.blurb: Initial reviews of Apple's new M5 Ultra Mac Studio highlight its massive unified memory pool and bandwidth, making it an unrivaled powerhouse for hosting local AI agents.
